posts.title: How to stand inside the total solar eclipse of 12 August 2026
posts.description: One thousand. That is the light gap between a 99 percent eclipse and a 100 percent eclipse. At 99 percent the open sliver of photosphere still pours about 1,000 lux over you, the light of an overcast noon. Your pupils adapt and nothing feels wrong. posts.title: Bazaar: adversarial asset direction
posts.description: The bazaar is not an art project, and this paper holds no prompt tricks. The bazaar is this site's index: a pixel-art night market, ten stalls, one route per stall, a talking keeper in each. gpt-image-class models generated every pixel. Codex CLI drove the jobs, Claude supervised the fleets, and I directed by eye. This paper is the engineering method.

posts.title: The landlords won
posts.description: On the morning of August 9, 1995, a sixteen-month-old company with no profits sold itself to the public. Netscape's bankers had priced the stock at $28. It touched $75 by the afternoon. Jim Clark, its co-founder, became the first internet paper-billionaire before the market closed.
